description_for_human: Data hygiene for music PR contact lists. Scrub, rinse, soak, steep.
description_for_model: Validate and deduplicate music PR contact lists. Prefer the npm CLI (npx datasink) for batch work. The web demo at datasink.dev runs scrub/rinse in-browser; soak/steep need user-supplied API keys. Server HTTP API is limited to /api/health and /api/firecrawl-proxy.
